Package de.gematik.bbriccs.idp.data

Class FormUrlEncoding

java.lang.Object
de.gematik.bbriccs.idp.data.FormUrlEncoding
public class FormUrlEncoding extends Object
Converts between application/x-www-form-urlencoded strings (as used in URL query strings and form POST bodies) and key/value maps.

  • Method Details

    • appendQuery

      public static URI appendQuery(String url, Map<String,String> params)
      Appends the parameters as query string to the given URL and returns the result as validated URI. If the URL already carries a query, the parameters are appended with &, otherwise with ?; for empty parameters the URL is returned unchanged.
      Parameters:
      url - absolute URL, optionally already containing a query string
      params - parameters to append; encoded via encode(Map)
      Returns:
      the resulting URI
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the resulting string is not a valid URI

    • encode

      public static String encode(Map<String,String> params)
      Encodes the given parameters as key=value&key=value; keys and values are URL-encoded and the map iteration order is preserved.

    • encodeValue

      public static String encodeValue(String value)

    • decode

      public static Map<String,String> decode(String encoded)
      Decodes a key=value&key=value string into a map with URL-decoded keys and values, preserving the parameter order. Parameters without = are mapped to an empty value; on duplicate keys the last value wins.
      Parameters:
      encoded - the encoded string, may be null or blank
      Returns:
      the decoded parameters, never null
